$comment: Shared golden-fixture corpus for the WebImage struct↔GCK converter (Phase 2 / T1). Read by both the iOS XCTest suite and the Android Robolectric suite. `input` is fed through struct→GCK→struct; the result must deep-equal `expectedRoundTrip`. Both platforms assert against the SAME expected values, so any iOS/Android divergence (or symmetric mapping bug captured here) fails the suite.

fixtures.name: no-dimensions
fixtures.$comment: GCK image dimensions are required ints; absent width/height become 0 and survive the round trip as 0 (not absent).
